title: Bag of Bricks - Dark Brown 30
descriptionHtml:
Dark Brown — colour 30

A deep chocolate tone that anchors a design. Use it for dark hair, tree bark and the shadow side of anything brown — it grounds an image the way black can be too blunt to do.

Works well with: Coffee 14, Brown 12, Toffee 29

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Dark Brown bricks (colour 30) for Memobrick mosaics. A deep chocolate tone for hair, tree bark and strong grounding shadows.
